layout.name: levelFilename
layout.title: Level Filename
layout.tooltip: Filename of the level that this tile leads to.

layout.name: levelTitle
layout.title: Level Title
layout.tooltip: Title shown when standing on this tile.

layout.name: warp
layout.title: Warp ID
layout.tooltip: The ID of the warp to enter through when going into the level.

layout.name: once
layout.title: Only Once
layout.tooltip: If enabled, the level cannot be enterable after beaten.

layout.name: stars
layout.title: Stars required
layout.tooltip: The amount of stars required to access this level.

layout.name: mark
layout.title: Mark on map as complete
layout.tooltip: If disabled, the level will not be visibly effected even if it's been beaten.

layout.name: helpcall
layout.title: Shout for help
layout.tooltip: If enabled, the level will have shout for help until it's beaten.

children.name: up
children.title: Top Unlock
children.tooltip: Type of victory needed to unlock the top.

children.name: right
children.title: Right Unlock
children.tooltip: Type of victory needed to unlock the right.

children.name: down
children.title: Bottom Unlock
children.tooltip: Type of victory needed to unlock the bottom.

children.name: left
children.title: Left Unlock
children.tooltip: Type of victory needed to unlock the left.

layout.name: vanishonwin
layout.title: Vanish on level completion
layout.tooltip: Turn invisible when the level is complete.

children.name: airship
children.title: Spawn Airship
children.tooltip: If enabled, the level will spawn an airship (by default 945, can be changed to the contents of the NPC).

children.name: airshipFilename
children.title: Airship Level Filename
children.tooltip: Filename of the standalone airship level, for when it's traveling beyond the level it's stationed at. If nothing's given, then it'll use the Level Filename instead.

children.name: airshipLayer
children.title: Airship Layer
children.tooltip: A layer for the airship to target instead of just going for any level in the section.

children.name: hideselfairship
children.title: Hide when airship spawns
children.tooltip: Make the level tile invisible when it's airship is active.

children.name: image
children.title: Level Thumbnail File
children.tooltip: A thumbnail to show for the level.

children.name: scale
children.title: Thumbnail Scale Multiplier
children.tooltip: How much the thumbnail's scale should be multiplied

children.name: noroot
children.title: Don't use smb3map root
children.tooltip: If enabled, the texture will not check the smb3map root directory for the file.

children.name: show
children.title: Reveal Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll be shown when the level's complete.

children.name: hide
children.title: Hide Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll be hidden when the level's complete.

children.name: toggle
children.title: Toggle Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll become hidden if it's shown and shown when it's hidden when the level's complete.

children.name: show
children.title: Reveal Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll be shown when the victory needed for the upwards direction is met.

children.name: hide
children.title: Hide Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll be hidden when the victory needed for the upwards direction is met.

children.name: toggle
children.title: Toggle Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll become hidden if it's shown and shown when the victory needed for the upwards direction is met.

children.name: show
children.title: Reveal Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll be shown when the victory needed for the downwards direction is met.

children.name: hide
children.title: Hide Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll be hidden when the victory needed for the downwards direction is met.

children.name: toggle
children.title: Toggle Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll become hidden if it's shown and shown when the victory needed for the downwards direction is met.

children.name: show
children.title: Reveal Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll be shown when the victory needed for the leftwards direction is met.

children.name: hide
children.title: Hide Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll be hidden when the victory needed for the leftwards direction is met.

children.name: toggle
children.title: Toggle Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll become hidden if it's shown and shown when the victory needed for the leftwards direction is met.

children.name: show
children.title: Reveal Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll be shown when the victory needed for the rightwards direction is met.

children.name: hide
children.title: Hide Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll be hidden when the victory needed for the rightwards direction is met.

children.name: toggle
children.title: Toggle Layer
children.tooltip: The layer that'll become hidden if it's shown and shown when the victory needed for the rightwards direction is met.

children.name: noSmoke
children.title: Disable smoke transition
children.tooltip: Disables the effect of the layer getting shown/hidden for the first time.

layout.name: idxsave
layout.title: Use idx to save
layout.tooltip: If enabled, instead of the level filename being used to save to the file, it'll use the idx of this NPC. Alright for toad houses that have the same layout. Will not work correctly if the level turns into an airship.
